itemCapCounts: the item text alone (the command, a prefix, a project name), separately from the fixed words
spokenTextCharacters: printable ASCII only: U+0020 to U+007E; any other character (control, newline, tab, bidi, non-ASCII letter or look-alike) makes the text read-only, not decidable by voice
untrustedText: the command, a prefix and the project name are host or agent text: spoken only when verified and whole (UntrustedText, not cut), the command always inside frame.command, and the fixed confirmation question after the frame; the same rule and cap apply to the dialog shown on screen
frame: The command is: {command}. End of command.
projectNameUnreadable: a project name over itemCapCharacters, not verified or outside printable ASCII is spoken as where.unreadable, and its items cannot be decided by voice (reason.project)
lockedBeforeFirstUnlock: keys are AfterFirstUnlock; before the first unlock since start every voice intent speaks refusal.locked and sends nothing
approveOnce: kind op, approveChoices.once true and approveChoices.limit null, sent as op approve-as once; approveChoices absent (old host): op approve, forwarded
approveWithGrant: only with voiceGrants on, only choices approveChoices offers: exact (exact true) -> approve-as exact; prefix (one of prefixes, byte for byte) -> approve-as prefix --prefix <words>; auto hour/session (in auto) -> approve-as auto-hour/auto-session. Never on an old host.
choiceNumbering: 1.. in choiceOrder over the offered choices only; prefixes 1..3 shortest first
notDecidable: command with a character outside printable ASCII (newline, control, bidi, non-ASCII)
command not verified, cut or empty
target: the oldest op item across hosts that the action may act on; the read-back names its project, and its host when another host has a project of the same name
